docs.name: ReadLockfile
docs.file_summary: `lock.go` defines `BundleEntry`, `Lockfile`, `ReadLockfile` and `WriteLockfile`. It is imported by 5 files (2 of them tests). Of the others, 3 are in `internal/cli`.

content.text:
ANSWER: `ReadLockfile` is defined in `pkg/lock/lock.go:45`. Three CLI command implementations in `internal/cli` call it, so a change to the `okf.lock` on-disk format would affect all three:
- `internal/cli/pull.go`: `cmdPull` calls `lock.ReadLockfile(lockPath)` at line 160.
- `internal/cli/restore.go`: `runRestore` calls `lock.ReadLockfile("okf.lock")` at line 64.
- `internal/cli/vendor.go`: `cmdVendor` calls `lock.ReadLockfile("okf.lock")` at line 37. The references list also shows a second call site in this file at line 62.

Tests that call it directly would also be affected: `TestCmdVendor_RemovePrefixSafeguard` in `internal/cli/restore_test.go` (line 106) and `TestLockfile_ReadWriteUpsert` in `pkg/lock/lock_test.go` (line 29). `WriteLockfile` lives in the same file, so it would need to change along with the format.

CONFIDENCE: high
